source.title: Mechanical Romance
source.description: You wonder why this mech was crashed here, and what this liquid is for. Maybe you can use it to reach the nearby islands and oil rig that seem to be connected to this mysterious organization. If there's one thing you know, it's that magical potions taste pretty good.
source.objective:
Find a use for the Guided Buoyancy Accelerant

Provided item:
source.completion: Reaching the oil rig, you spot a man in a lab coat tinkering with some robots. He notices you and shouts out while still fiddling with controls. "Fantastic! You're just in time. I've been expecting you. You're the one who drank my wonderful potion, right? I'm Dr. Jurgens, and I have a proposition for you."
